plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Hytera digital repeaters (HYTERA-REPEATER-MIB, enterprise PEN 40297). It reports uptime, PA temperature, supply voltage, transmitter forward power, voltage and temperature alarm states, and interface traffic.
name: Wireless

metrics.name: pa_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Power amplifier temperature of the Hytera repeater in degrees Celsius, from rptPaTemprature (HYTERA-REPEATER-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.40297.1.2.1.2.2.0, 4-byte little-endian IEEE 754 float). The object is invalid on RD960; values outside -60 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Supply voltage of the Hytera repeater in volts, from rptVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.40297.1.2.1.2.1.0, 4-byte little-endian IEEE 754 float). The object is invalid on RD620 / RD960; values outside 0 to 100 V are dropped.

metrics.name: voltage_alarm_state
metrics.description: Voltage alarm of the Hytera repeater from rptVoltageAlarm (1.3.6.1.4.1.40297.1.2.1.1.1.0): 0 normal maps to 1 (normal); 1 low voltage, 2 high voltage and 3 abnormal map to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: temperature_alarm_state
metrics.description: Temperature alarm of the Hytera repeater from rptTemperatureAlarm (1.3.6.1.4.1.40297.1.2.1.1.2.0): 0 normal maps to 1 (normal); 1 low temperature and 2 high temperature map to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: tx_forward_power_watts
metrics.description: Transmitter forward power of the Hytera repeater in watts, from rptTxFwdPower (1.3.6.1.4.1.40297.1.2.1.2.5.0, 4-byte little-endian IEEE 754 float). The object is invalid on RD620 / RD960; values outside 0 to 1000 W are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
